item.title: bcrypt vs Argon2id vs scrypt in 2026: Which Password Hashing Algorithm Should You Actually Ship?
item.description: Your database is one leaked backup away from being a credential dump. In 2026 the average attacker rents GPU time by the minute, and a password hash that cost 200 ms to produce on your server costs a few microseconds per guess on hardware that was designed for exactly this job. Hashing is the only control standing between a stolen table row and a working login — and the algorithm you pick decides how long that wall holds.
